items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1959-10-03
items.q: Johnny's in Los Angeles too, yeah.

ctx.x: Well, I'd love to find an 88 year old bass player. Yeah. What part of California? Los Angeles. Los Angeles, yeah. That's right. Well, we'll find him, somehow. Johnny St. Seah ought to know where he is. I bet you they know each other.
Johnny's in Los Angeles too, yeah. I bet Johnny, I know Johnny doesn't found him since he's been out there. I'm sure he is. That would be great.
We can find him too, man. You know more people all over. Yeah. I got a fella right now, play bass with me.
